mapper.select:
SELECT e.id, e.name, e.job_type, e.birth_date, e.mobile, e.retired_at, d.seniority_no, e.role, e.enabled, e.login_id IS NOT NULL AS has_account FROM hd_employee e LEFT JOIN hd_driver d ON d.employee_name = e.name
ORDER BY d.seniority_no NULLS LAST, e.name LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT e.id, e.name, e.job_type, e.birth_date, e.mobile, e.retired_at, d.seniority_no, e.role, e.enabled, e.login_id IS NOT NULL AS has_account FROM hd_employee e LEFT JOIN hd_driver d ON d.employee_name = e.name WHERE e.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hd_employee (name, job_type, birth_date, mobile) VALUES (#{name}, #{jobType}, #{birthDate}, #{mobile})
mapper.update: UPDATE hd_employee SET name = #{name}, job_type = #{jobType}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, mobile = #{mobile}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hd_driver (employee_name, seniority_no) VALUES (#{employeeName}, #{seniorityNo}) ON CONFLICT (employee_name) DO UPDATE SET seniority_no = EXCLUDED.seniority_no, updated_at = now()
mapper.update: UPDATE hd_driver SET employee_name = #{newName}, updated_at = now() WHERE employee_name = #{oldName}
UPDATE hd_employee SET retired_at = #{retiredAt}, enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE hd_driver SET seniority_no = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE employee_name = #{employeeName}
